image_description: A close-up view of the facade pipes of a pipe organ. The image shows multiple vertical metal pipes of varying diameters and heights, arranged in a wooden case with decorative moldings. The central focus is on a cluster of large, polished metallic pipes (likely tin or lead alloy) with pointed tops (languids/mouths visible). To the left and right are smaller pipes, some with spiral decorations. The lighting creates strong reflections on the metallic surfaces.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of organ pipes and rule out misclassification as generic industrial pipes or architectural columns.
To verify the physical separation between the foreground pipes and the background wooden structure, ensuring no 'melting' or depth collapse.
To check for edge bleeding between the shiny metal pipes and the wood, and to ensure the cylindrical topology of the pipes is maintained without warping.
To assess the realism of the metallic reflections and wood grain textures, looking for subtle AI-generated noise or smearing.

focus_areas: Metallic reflection consistency on curved pipe surfaces
Boundary sharpness between pipes and wooden background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the central large pipes. In AI images, complex reflections on curved metallic surfaces often distort or become inconsistent with the light source. Verify if the reflections align with a single coherent environment. Also, check the 'mouths' (the openings near the bottom of the visible pipe sections) for anatomical correctness—do they have the proper labium and windway structure, or do they look melted/undefined?
